SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.118

New page, Administration → WhatsApp (Admin only), with three ways to send a PDF:
Chat link (the default, as before): the PDF downloads, WhatsApp opens with the message, and you attach the PDF yourself.
Share menu: the Windows or phone share menu passes WhatsApp the PDF and the message together; you pick the contact and press send. WhatsApp allows this.
Linked WhatsApp number: a number linked to the app (like WhatsApp Web) sends the PDF and message straight to the customer’s number. Send receipts gets a WhatsApp the ticked button that sends them one by one and marks each as sent.
Setting up the linked number:
Click Install the WhatsApp link. It downloads the library into the data folder in a minute or two (the server needs internet access).
Enter the number to link, then click Get the code.
On that phone, open WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device → Link with phone number instead, and type the 8-character code.
Use Send test to check it works. Unlink this number is on the same page.
Safeguards for the linked number:
Messages go 4–7 seconds apart, at a person’s pace.
There’s a daily limit, set by the new WhatsAppDailyLimit setting (default 100).
Only Admin, Accounts, Finance Manager and Cashier can send, and only PDFs made by the app.
Every send is recorded in the audit log.
New settings: WhatsAppMode and WhatsAppDailyLimit.
